rows.TEXT:
Pegasus Knight
"We have captured all the cities Milord. The region is ours!"

Mage
"The Mountain Clans have sent us a message. They have declared war on us! Why do they betray us when we are in need of their help?"

Mage
"The Mountain Clans have cut all diplomatic relations with us, Milord... They are massing troops near their capital, I fear the worst!"

Dagaric Stormcaller
"Greetings humans! Dagaric welcomes you! I am a member of the dwarven High Council, and friend of Morok Cloudkeeper, our High King..."

Uther
"You will aid us in punishing the traitors, then?"

Dagaric Stormcaller
"We will aid you and respect our alliance... The Mountain Clans live by honor and always keep their word."

Dagarik Stormcaller
"I bear you no grudge, young Uther! But Morok Cloudkeeper has ordered us to destroy you... As his subject, I have no choice but to comply with his crazed commands!"

Uther
"A great mistake... We will crush you for your betrayal, half-men!"
Dagarik Stormcaller"You should understand this about Morok... Since he lost his son Gymner, he is desperate for revenge. He is not fit to rule, but all his people must follow his judgments!"

Uther
"Ha ha ha... We have nothing in common, half-men! Your story of Morok and his pathetic son Gymner does not touch me... It only makes me scorn your people the more!"

Dagaric Stormcaller
"Morok's judgement of you was borne of madness... But his pronouncements were unwittingly correct! I will meet you next on the battlefield, scoundrel!"

Priest
"Uther is dead! Oh, our struggle was for naught! The Empire is lost... There is no way we can survive these times without Uther's might!"

Ranger
"The city of Avonia has fallen to Greenskins... Trolls have wiped out the populace! We must take it back!"
Master Thug"You will never recapture the cities you seek... Trolls have infested the mountains below, they even seem to be organized into small bands! Ha ha ha!"

Initiate
"One day, the Empire army will not be able to protect you, Uther..."
Uther"It is time for me to reclaim what my father lost... Prepare our troops! Let us subdue these disloyal nobles!"

Uther
"The riotous cities lie south, let's take them back!"

Dwarf
"Treacherous human scum! Morok will make you pay for your arrogance... We will meet again!"

Dagaric Stormcaller
"You have fought well, humans... Forgive Morok, he i.. is not an evil dwarf... Wotan awaits me at his e...eternal feast t...able."

Orc
"Ghoo human! You die in Toll mountan... Ghrrrrrr..."

Spearman 
"Why do you attack us? Have you nothing more important to do than turn against your kin?"

Uther
"Traitors! You turn against your masters? Treason is punishable by death... Execute them!"

Spearman
"How dare you invade our lands! Demosthene has done nothing for us... Orcs, trolls and goblins have infested these lands for years, all of our pleas for help were unanswered!"

Archer
"Crossing these mountains will bring us near our goal; as the rebel cities can be found on the other side... Be wary Milord, it is said that Trolls plague these mountains!"

Spearman
"I will never pledge to Demosthene! He is a weak ruler... He has not aided us ever since the queen died and Uther disappeared!"

Uther
"Uther has returned! Bow before your new ruler..."

Spearman
"Uther?! If you really are Uther, then we shall serve you! We are yours to command..."

Squire
"Lord Uther! Avonia Castle is secure! All of the Trolls have been destroyed..."

Ranger
"This passage will lead us to the rebel cities... Beware of the Trolls, they are aggressive in these mountains!"

Vampire
"Even the mighty Uther isss vulnerable to Mortis' embrace... Death to the living!"

Uther
"Mortis will be no more than a name when I am finished with her puny Hordes..."

Uther
"Rock city inhabitants! Bow before the Emperor's son, or I shall crush your ridiculous forces..."

Uther
"I want Demosthene's enemies destroyed! They will pay for their arrogance... Leave their corpses to the dogs!"

Peasant Emand
"Please save me and my children! The evil Trolls destroyed my farm... The work of a lifetime lost! What's that?! flee! a Troll approaches!"

Duke
"What is that?! The Empire sent a boy to attack us? It is time to put the Empire out of its misery... Ha ha ha!"

Uther
"Laugh all you want, demons! Soon you will be no more! Prepare yourselves to meet your new master..."

Peasant
"You saved me! I must reveal my family secret to you, you have proved worthy... Long ago..."
Peasant"One of my ancestors was a great fighter, and he recorded all of his secrets in a book. His house has long been abandoned, but perhaps the Tome is still there..."

Ranger
"Beware Milord! Trolls plague these mountains; they prey upon unfortunate travelers..."

Spearman
"I align myself with you, Uther! Please forgive our betrayal; accept my troops in your army..."
Take a look at my wares, I may have something of interest to you.
My items were created decades ago by a powerful Magi...
Are you in need of healing?
Are you in need of recruits? My men are trained by the best!
I have some powerful new spells that might interest you.
In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.
